test_title: PYST 32: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3d545e4b8cc3e1046776c0c020dfeb354a6c70c20534de80f86c481de4c7692.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.

1. EH - DG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9acfba2a4d02bc4d6c96029f453982db202afa49ddcbcadb0324b5b8aef4f0fd.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.
2. OR - NQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4c2e2ffc35e33ad54afeefcc51eb917bf574bc16644ad3fda85a0327372f84f.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.
3. QT - PT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/686a4a8c2018d8ca60cff3d00ab1f900dcd2e32c373e9239e5a62a653618eb12.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -1, -1.
4. LO - KN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f157aa4a55cdc149f72d80d4d4aa898281a7f4479a0c0180db6bc33a033bf62a.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -1, -1.

Thus, QT - PT is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
